title: walkthrough data-select strips the authored filmcard.sel from history sheets
notes: Any wt step with data-select clears sel/selc from every .filmcard in the stage (walkthrough.js data-select handler), so the history pane loses its authored one-selected-card state (history.css says ship with ONE .filmcard.sel so the action row is visible) once a user steps a walkthrough. Affects every wt page with a hist sheet, e.g. composites, component-configure-wt. Fix idea: scope the deselect sweep to the panels the step actually selects in, or exclude .filmcard strips that carry data-radio.
